items.hint: Listen for the speaker’s name and who joins that person in мы.
items.explanation: Oleg is the speaker. He and Nina read together; Anna talks.
items.expectation: Identify the speaker and the named other reader in мы, while distinguishing the person who is talking.
items.transcript: Привет! Я Олег. Сейчас я читаю. Нина тоже читает. Мы читаем вместе. Анна говорит по-русски.

items.hint: The question is a possibility, not the answer. Follow Nina’s reply.
items.explanation: The question asks whether Nina is reading. She says she is not reading and is speaking Russian instead.
items.expectation: Use Nina’s negative reply and stated current action, rather than treating the polite question as a report of what she is doing.
items.transcript:
— Нина, вы сейчас читаете?
— Нет, я не читаю. Сейчас я говорю по-русски.

items.hint: Тоже adds another person doing the same action. Do not confuse speaking with the action that is denied.
items.explanation: Anna and Oleg speak Russian, and Nina does too. All three are speaking; the message says they are not reading.
items.expectation: Combine the named pair with the additional speaker introduced by тоже, distinguishing their shared action from the negated action.
items.transcript: Сейчас Анна и Олег говорят по-русски. Нина тоже говорит по-русски. Они не читают.
